answer: Because the timing is written down against the lantern challenge, the jade audit can replay the thread history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 76 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1431 identities would post 1154 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
